---
name: verify-first
description: Before claiming what exists, which service has a secret, what T12 is, or what a command does — open the file, the live CLI help, or the API. Use when discussing TrustShell, Railway, RepID, Trinity, or any inventory.
---

Name the tree in the sentence (npm 1.3.0 / GitHub main / Railway service X / unpushed laptop / Supabase project ref).

Do not treat a shared variable catalog as a grant list. Shared = pool. ADDED = this service. ADD = not on this service.

Do not treat a run conclusion as every job. Read jobs.

Do not invent a recorder, identity layer, or CLI command that already lives in another DealAppSeo repo. Search org code first.

If you cannot open the artifact, say NOT CHECKED. Never fill the gap with a fluent guess.

Synthetic demos must be labelled in the user-visible message, not only in a tool log.

Privileges: REVOKE per role, then has_function_privilege for that role. REVOKE FROM PUBLIC is not enough.

Any "anon can X" claim must be tested over HTTP with a publishable key, not only with SET ROLE. Disabling legacy JWT keys does not reduce what the anon role can do through PostgREST /rest/v1/rpc.
